title: shade the fraction
seam: every part of the whole: data-part="<index from 0>" and data-shaded="true|false" kept current; one element per part, the drawn shape itself
the target fraction, written as numerals: an element with data-target
brief: KIND: game. Fractions as equal parts of a whole.

ACTIVITY: for each item of Studio.params.items in order: a whole (Studio.params.picture: a round pizza cut into equal wedges, or a bar cut into equal segments) divided into item.d EQUAL parts, and the target item.n/item.d as numerals. The child taps a part to colour it and taps again to un-colour it, then presses check -> Studio.answer({n: <coloured count>, d: item.d}).
On a correct verdict: a short celebration, then the next item. On a wrong verdict: gentle feedback, the parts stay as they are so the child can fix them and check again.
After the last item: the done screen and Studio.done().
All parts start un-coloured and look identical until tapped.
antiPatterns: parts drawn as one path with internal lines (each part must be its own element carrying the seam)
advancing to the next item on a wrong answer
the numerator pre-coloured, or the coloured count shown before check
